appearance.organs.panicle.note: The panicle's layout, the model's choice after GrassBase, as search results quote it (the page was not read): open and lanceolate, 6 to 12 cm, with large spikelets. Drawn as 6 branches of about 4 spikelets each. Colours by eye.

traits.note: GrassBase's account of the species, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): panicle open, lanceolate, 6 to 12 cm; spikelets 14 to 15 mm, of 4 to 6 fertile florets; glumes shorter than the spikelet, the lower 4.5 to 6.5 mm, the upper 6.5 to 8 mm; fertile lemma 6.5 to 12 mm; its one awn 1 to 5 mm, from a tapering tip (the tip in the search results' own words). No other flora's account was found to check it against.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: the dominant tussock grass of the Patagonian steppe, a dense, wiry, yellowish-green tuft 30 to 60 cm tall of fine, rolled leaves, with much old straw-coloured thatch, standing in a sea of tussocks across the wind-swept plains. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 0.6 m at 4 years. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: yellow-green blades, straw thatch.
